annotations.title: Who to reach out to, from a CV

description: Who to reach out to, from a CV. For "who should I network with?", "how do I get a job as a data scientist without applying cold?". From a CV or a few details and the role wanted, gives the kinds of people worth contacting in order (hiring managers at the employers hiring most for the role, recruiters who place it, alumni, former colleagues, people who made the same move, community organisers), with ready searches, the employers hiring most now and named people from public posts. Nothing sent is stored.

cv.description: The CV as plain text. Optional if titles and skills are given.

employers.description: Current and past employers, comma separated.

goal_role.description: The job the person is aiming for, for example "data scientist".

location.description: Where the person lives or wants to work.

school.description: A university or school, for alumni.

titles.description: Current and past job titles, comma separated.
